english.title: Cause use of a vehicle / trailer no mudguards / wings fitted

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..),

(A)_[a heavy motor car, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[a motor car, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(C)_[a motor cycle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(D)_[an invalid carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(E)_[a trailer,]_

which was not equipped with wings or other similar fittings to catch, so far as practicable, mud or water thrown up by the rotation of its wheels and tracks
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 63(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused use on a road
heavy motor car/motor car/motor cycle/invalid carriage/trailer
not equipped with wings/similar fittings

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 63 also applies to invalid carriages and agricultural motor vehicles driven at more than 20 mph.
(ii) See regulation 63(4) and (5) for exceptions.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3363 and H3371.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was not equipped with mudguards .

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
